transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
Hi, it's Carlos Mendes, I'm an existing patient and I'd like to see Dr. Smith.
Thanks, Carlos. May I have your date of birth?
Dr. Smith has Monday at 10 AM, Wednesday at 2 PM, or Friday at 2 PM.
Booked: Carlos Mendes, Friday at 2 PM. A confirmation will be sent. Thank you, goodbye.
